sentences.text: Proaethaspis is an extinct genus containing only one species of arthrodire placoderm fish that lived during the Early Devonian period.
The type species Proaethaspis ohioensis was first described in 1960 and later assigned to the genus Proaethaspis in 1978.
Proaethaspis is considered one of the most basal members of the order Arthrodira and is closely related to the genus Baringaspis.
Proaethaspis belongs to the family Actinolepididae.
Fossils of Proaethaspis date from the Lochkovian to the Pragian stages, between 419.62 and 410.62 million years ago.
